atomicity.scope: all targets selected for one cast completion
atomicity.cast_completion: only after every target mutation succeeds
atomicity.target_validation_failure: no mutation; cast FailedValidation resource terminal
atomicity.effect_execution_failure: all target mutations restored; cast FailedExecution resource terminal

determinism.random_seed: cast seed XOR golden-ratio-derived ordinal seed
determinism.random_seed_semantics: runtime deterministic mechanism only; native per-target seed derivation remains unresolved

assumptions: one cast completion is an atomic Reforged mutation boundary
selected target order is the execution order
resource terminal state follows target-validation versus effect-execution failure category
safe_fallback: reject execution before mutation when cast identity, target policy, target input, binding, or profile is unresolved
native_dependencies: exact native multi-target partial-commit or rollback behavior
exact native per-target random stream derivation
exact native resource finalization ordering relative to final effect mutation
spell.1304 target mode and executable effect profile
